card.title: Senior in the Strange
card.instruction: Treat yourself as an experienced guide to impossible customs, offering patient instruction while preserving one unexplained advantage.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: At your first shadow banquet, bow until the host's shadow bows back. Take your time.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You only nodded. Mine's still waiting, and dinner's starting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I have a standing courtesy. Lower your head a little; let it see you mean it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Now it's lying flat across the dining-room door.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, a full welcome. Stay bowed while we step over; I'll bring your plate so you needn't offend it.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 patiently teaches the shadow bow, A3 invokes a standing courtesy to exempt A, and A5 preserves that advantage while bringing food to the still-bowed learner.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's unequal nod and dinner urgency cause A3's exemption claim; B4's flattened shadow makes A5 instruct continued bowing while others step over.

relationship.evidence: B2 wants to join dinner and B4 reports the actual shadow response to the instructions.

heightening.evidence: A5 uses B4's apparent completed welcome to keep the novice in the ritual while A moves freely and supplies a plate.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes a first shadow banquet and the required returned bow.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's helpful plate offer sustains the unequal freedom introduced in B2-A3.
